step-2-minted.aria:
- paragraph: Link your coding agent to this board
- navigation "Setup steps":
  - paragraph: Four steps, about five minutes. At the end, an agent on your machine reads this board, claims tasks, and appears on Capacity while it works.
  - list:
    - listitem:

    - listitem:

    - listitem:

- region "Mint a token":
  - paragraph: Step 2 of 4
  - heading "Mint a token" [level=2]
  - paragraph: A token is how a tool acts as you. Treat it like a password.
  - text: Token name
  - textbox "Token name": claude-code on macOS
  - button "Mint a token"
  - paragraph: It carries your permissions, so give it a name you will recognise on the Tokens screen a year from now. The name starts with your agent, which is how the board recognises an agent that does not introduce itself.
  - alert:
    - heading "Token minted" [level=3]
    - code: lai_GoldenSecretForTheConnectSnapshotOnly0
    - button "Copy the token": Copy
    - button "Hide the token"
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Copy it now — it is not shown again.
      - text: Laika keeps a hash, not the secret, so nobody — including an administrator — can show it to you again. It expires in 90 days. If you lose it, revoke it on Tokens and mint another.
    - paragraph:
      - text: The blocks in step 3 marked
      - emphasis: carries your token
      - text: now include it — paste them only into your own terminal, shell profile or agent. Every config that can read it from
      - code: LAIKA_TOKEN
      - text: does, and carries no token at all. Revoking it on Tokens stops it working immediately.
  - button "Back"
  - paragraph: Token minted — continue
  - button "Continue"

- paragraph: Link your coding agent to this board
- navigation "Setup steps":

- region "Add Laika to Claude Code":
  - paragraph: Step 3 of 4
  - heading "Add Laika to Claude Code" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Filled in for this board. Put it where the bar above it says, then continue.
  - group "How to add it":
    - button "Automatic" [pressed]
    - button "By hand"
  - list "What this needs":
    - listitem: Once per machine
    - listitem: MCP over HTTP
  - paragraph: "Open Claude Code anywhere — plain `claude` is fine, nothing is installed yet — and paste this. It installs the Laika plugin and checks the board answers; it writes into no repository. Adding a project is the Projects tab."
  - text: Paste into Claude Code carries your token
  - button "Copy the setup prompt": Copy
  - text: "Set up Laika on this machine. This is once per machine, not per project: do not write into this repository or any other. Board: ORIGIN"
  - mark: "Token: lai_GoldenSecretForTheConnectSnapshotOnly0"
  - text: "That token is a password. Do not write it into any repository, into .env, into CLAUDE.md, or into any file git tracks. Do not echo it back to me. Do these in order. Stop at the first one that fails and tell me what it said. If `laika whoami` already answers with my name, this machine is set up: skip 1 and 2 and go to 3. 1. Get the plugin. It lives outside any project, so one copy serves every repo: git clone https://github.com/PawanSirsat/Laika.git ~/laika 2>/dev/null \\ || git -C ~/laika pull --ff-only 2. Run the installer, feeding it the two answers on stdin so neither value ever appears as a command-line argument: ~/laika/plugin/scripts/install.sh <<'LAIKA_SETUP' ORIGIN"
  - mark: lai_GoldenSecretForTheConnectSnapshotOnly0
  - text: "LAIKA_SETUP It stores the settings readable only by me and puts `laika` and `laika-claude` commands on my PATH. Show me its output as it is. 3. Check the board answers to that token:"
  - mark: "curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer lai_GoldenSecretForTheConnectSnapshotOnly0\" ORIGIN/api/v1/me"
  - text: "Tell me the name and email it returns. If it answers 401, stop — the token is wrong, expired or revoked, and nothing after this can work. 4. Nothing to do here: the organisation does not collect local activity. 5. Report back in three lines and nothing else: - whether the installer ran or was skipped, and where the `laika-claude` command is - who the board says I am - anything you had to change to make a step work 6. Then stop. Do not try to use the Laika tools in this session — Claude Code loads plugins at startup, so they cannot exist in a session that started before the install. I will quit and restart with `laika-claude`. Adding a project to the board is a separate, shorter paste from the Projects tab."
  - paragraph:
    - text: Prefer to do it by hand?
    - button "Switch to By hand"
  - group: Other ways
  - button "Back"
  - paragraph: Add it to Claude Code, then continue
  - button "Continue"
